concerns.text: FR-001 (Data Ingestion) and FR-007/FR-008 (Error Logging/Fallback) lack a dedicated task for the actual data download and checksum verification. T004 implements the API logic but T006 (Data downloaders to save raw CSV/Parquet with checksum verification) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). Without T006, the 'Data Hygiene' (Constitution III) and 'Verified Accuracy' (Constitution II) requirements for checksumming raw data are not covered by any task.

FR-007 (Logging API errors) is partially covered by T004 (retry logic) but T018 (Add logging for all API errors... with configurable retry counts) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The spec requires explicit logging of errors and configurable retry counts; T004 only mentions the logic, not the logging artifact. T018 is the only task explicitly addressing the logging requirement.

FR-010 (Isolate bottom [deferred] subset) and SC-001 (Measure MAE change on minority subset) rely on T026 (Implement evaluation.py to isolate bottom [deferred] subset). However, T026 is marked [X] (completed) but T016 (Generate baseline performance report) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The baseline report (US-1) is a prerequisite for the comparison in US-2. If T016 is missing, the 'Independent Test' for US-1 fails, and the comparison in US-2 has no baseline to compare against.

FR-005 (Paired statistical tests) and SC-002 (Statistical significance) require T029 (Implement paired statistical tests). T029 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). Without T029, the core research question of 'statistically comparing performance metrics' cannot be answered, leaving FR-005 and SC-002 uncovered.

FR-012 (Correlation between ImbalanceScore and performance degradation) requires T030 and T031. Both are marked [ ] (unimplemented). The spec explicitly requires computing and reporting these correlations; without these tasks, FR-012 and SC-004 are not covered.

FR-006 (SHAP values and rank comparison) and FR-014 (Synthetic ground truth) require T036, T037, T038, T039, T040, T041. All are marked [ ] (unimplemented). The entire User Story 3 (SHAP analysis) is unimplemented, leaving FR-006, FR-014, SC-003, and the 'Independent Test' for US-3 uncovered.

Constraint-001 (Pipeline < 6 hours) and Constraint-002 (Memory < 7 GB) require T045 (Memory profiling) and T047 (Quickstart validation). Both are marked [ ] (unimplemented). Without these tasks, the operational constraints cannot be verified or enforced.

T006 is marked [ ] (unimplemented) but the task description says 'Implement data downloaders...'. The task exists but is not completed. This is a status issue, not a coverage issue, but the lack of completion blocks the pipeline. However, the task itself covers the requirement.
T018 is marked [ ] (unimplemented) but the task description says 'Add logging...'. The task exists but is not completed. This is a status issue, not a coverage issue.
T029, T030, T031, T032 are marked [ ] (unimplemented). The tasks exist but are not completed. This is a status issue, not a coverage issue.
T036-T042 are marked [ ] (unimplemented). The tasks exist but are not completed. This is a status issue, not a coverage issue.
T043-T048 are marked [ ] (unimplemented). The tasks exist but are not completed. This is a status issue, not a coverage issue.
